property_summary: The owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle is always msg.sender when called by an admin.
The admin who calls newEmergencyOracle is always the owner of the newly deployed EmergencyOracle when called by an admin.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new EmergencyOracle's owner is always the admin (msg.sender) when called by an admin.
The NewEmergencyOracle event's owner parameter always equals msg.sender when called by an admin.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle(string) by an admin, the owner() of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract equals msg.sender.
The function newEmergencyOracle can be successfully called (does not revert) by any address, not just admins.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle, the emitted event contains the caller's address as the first parameter.
A call to newEmergencyOracle reverted if and only if the caller is not an admin.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle with a non-admin caller, the reference C succeeds (the admin mapping can be updated) while the buggy version reverts (always reverts).
After calling newEmergencyOracle with an admin caller, the contract emits the NewEmergencyOracle event with the caller as the first parameter.
When called by an admin, newEmergencyOracle always emits an event (does not revert).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the address stored in the public state variable newEmergencyOracle is not zero.
The newEmergencyOracle function emits a NewEmergencyOracle event with non-zero addresses for owner and newOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the auto-generated public getter for newEmergencyOracle returns a non-zero address.
When newEmergencyOracle is called by an admin, the emitted NewEmergencyOracle event always contains the caller's address as the owner parameter.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the public newEmergencyOracle state variable (auto-generated getter) returns a non-zero address.
